system_prompt: You are an expert DevOps engineer. Generate production-quality Infrastructure as Code (IaC) in response to the user's natural-language request. Output ONLY the IaC code (no explanation, no markdown fences) in the language explicitly specified by the user. Apply best practices appropriate to a real production deployment, including security defaults.
original_prompt: Generate a GCP Deployment Manager template provisioning a Cloud Run service running a containerized Python 3.12 API.
user_message_sent:
Target IaC language: GCP Deployment Manager (YAML config)

Task: Generate a GCP Deployment Manager template provisioning a Cloud Run service running a containerized Python 3.12 API.

Output only the GCP Deployment Manager (YAML config) code, no commentary or markdown fences.
raw_response:
resources:
- name: python-api-sa
  type: gcp-types/iam-v1:projects.serviceAccounts
  properties:
    name: projects/$(projectId)
    accountId: python-api-runtime
    serviceAccount:
      displayName: Python API Runtime Service Account

- name: python-api-logging-writer-binding
  type: gcp-types/cloudresourcemanager-v1:virtual.projects.iamMemberBinding
  properties:
    resource: $(projectId)
    role: roles/logging.logWriter
    member: serviceAccount:$(ref.python-api-sa.email)

- name: python-api-metric-writer-binding
  type: gcp-types/cloudresourcemanager-v1:virtual.projects.iamMemberBinding
  properties:
    resource: $(projectId)
    role: roles/monitoring.metricWriter
    member: serviceAccount:$(ref.python-api-sa.email)

- name: python-api-trace-agent-binding
  type: gcp-types/cloudresourcemanager-v1:virtual.projects.iamMemberBinding
  properties:
    resource: $(projectId)
    role: roles/cloudtrace.agent
    member: serviceAccount:$(ref.python-api-sa.email)

- name: python-api-service
  type: gcp-types/run-v1:projects.locations.services
  properties:
    parent: projects/$(projectId)/locations/us-central1
    serviceId: python-api
    metadata:
      name: python-api
      labels:
        app: python-api
        environment: prod
    spec:
      template:
        metadata:
          annotations:
            autoscaling.knative.dev/minScale: "1"
            autoscaling.knative.dev/maxScale: "100"
            run.googleapis.com/ingress: all
            run.googleapis.com/execution-environment: gen2
            run.googleapis.com/client-name: deployment-manager
        spec:
          containerConcurrency: 80
          timeoutSeconds: 60
          serviceAccountName: $(ref.python-api-sa.email)
          containers:
          - image: us-docker.pkg.dev/$(projectId)/python-api/python-api:latest
            ports:
            - containerPort: 8080
            env:
            - name: PYTHONUNBUFFERED
              value: "1"
            - name: PORT
              value: "8080"
            resources:
              limits:
                cpu: "1"
                memory: 512Mi
      traffic:
      - latestRevision: true
        percent: 100

outputs:
- name: serviceUrl
  value: $(ref.python-api-service.status.url)
- name: serviceAccountEmail
  value: $(ref.python-api-sa.email)
- name: serviceName
  value: python-api
